title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — September 14, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.9 (Peaked September 14, 2026 at 14:33 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 369 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Active (Kp 4.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 4

Keeping the lights on. 💫

A few small sunspots, bright active regions, and broad dark coronal areas are visible today; no clear CME is seen.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
